u-same-top-byte/a0/structured:
c at p0 0
still at p0 1
bit_pos shr p2 p1
bit_val and bit_pos 1
is_set ne bit_val 0
should_count and still is_set
new_c1 add c 1
new_count select should_count new_c1 c
new_still and still is_set
result rec new_count new_still
ret result

u-trailing-ones/a0/structured:
v at p0 0
c at p0 1
b shr p2 p1
e and b 1
ne_zero ne e 0

new_c select ne_zero c 0
result rec new_v new_c
ret result
